Approved evidence

Dataloop

org.dataloop

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Current provider documentation received separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI content reviews for the exact imported observations. The proposed category is software for unstructured data operations, annotation and feedback orchestration. Prebuilt workflows combine human and AI feedback for RLHF/RLAIF; data cleaning, curation and versioning remain platform features. Separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews are complete for the exact imported observations. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes are retained; no operational audit, commercial quality endorsement or automatic review of mentioned benchmarks is implied.
